resources.string: Unsupported, incomplete or unverified content is omitted. Only selectable messages can be published.
All history and From a message cover the complete catalog, not just the loaded pages. Load more messages to pick from them.
Off by default. When enabled, only new completed messages after activation are added. Messages during a disabled interval are not backfilled.
Off by default. Includes associated intermediate text, tool arguments and results. Execution remains collapsed until the reader opens it.
Default: 3 days. A link can never last beyond 30 days after creation. Editing chooses a deadline measured from creation.
Redaction cannot remove every sensitive fact. Check the full preview for private information before sharing. Changing any option requires a new preview.
This link will stop working and cannot be restored. Content already downloaded cannot be recalled.
Mark messages to remove, then Save changes. This uses sealed history and does not need the source computer.
Copy this link now. Once you leave this screen it cannot be shown again, and the app does not save it.
Link copied. It is not saved anywhere in the app.
The link may have been created, but cannot be retrieved. Refresh existing links, revoke any uncertain creation, then create a new link. Do not retry creation.
This share changed. Refresh existing links and reopen it before editing. Your old preview is no longer valid.
The connection or sharing authority changed. Close this sheet and reopen it on the current connection.
Sharing requires an enrolled owner and a session explicitly bound to that owner. Ask your hub administrator to verify ownership.
This source cannot currently provide complete, verified sharing history. Existing links can still be inspected or revoked.
Prepare and review a fresh preview, then acknowledge it.
Your hub needs a configured independent public sharing origin before creating links.
This link uses HTTP. The link token and selected content travel without encryption. Someone observing the network may obtain them and read this share. HTTPS is recommended.
Save message removals separately before enabling options or extending this share.
The sharing request failed. Refresh before trying again.
That creation-based deadline has already passed. Choose a later deadline.
Choose at most 1,000 individual messages per change.
Messages whose sender cannot be verified
Tool work not tied to a reply
